title: Mara and the Vector
author: C. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Lena Nakamura, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
